notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {6}{R}{G}{W}.
description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Zacama, adding one mana of any color.
Zacama dies, triggering Enduring Renewal, returning Zacama to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Zacama by paying {6}{R}{G}{W}.
Zacama triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Zacama's abilities.
